## Econometric research for consequential policy questions

I am an emerging economist and econometrician studying monetary institutions, digital currencies, governance capacity, and the application of computational methods to public policy. My work combines empirical discipline with an interest in how institutions respond to technological change, financial transformation, and strategic competition.

[View my research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [View my CV](cv.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

::: {.hero-aside}
**Current focus**

- Monetary-policy transmission and central-bank balance sheets
- Causal policy evaluation and applied econometrics
- Strategic trade, governance, and economic intelligence

*Preparing for doctoral study in economics and political economy.*
:::
:::

## Selected research

::: {.project-feature}
### CBDC and Monetary Transmission in Switzerland

An empirical study of whether a CBDC pilot altered the transmission of monetary-policy shocks through lending, deposit, and exchange-rate channels.

**Methods:** OLS with HAC standard errors, interaction models, and time-series analysis  
**Status:** Graduate research paper

[Project overview](projects.qmd#cbdc-and-monetary-transmission-in-switzerland) · [Paper PDF — add link](#) · [Repository — add link](#)
:::

::: {.project-feature}
### Quantitative Easing and the Balance-Sheet Channel

An investigation of how Federal Reserve asset holdings and duration removal relate to the ten-year Treasury term premium.

**Methods:** Newey–West inference, vector autoregression, impulse responses, and forecast-error variance decomposition  
**Status:** Research project

[Project overview](projects.qmd#quantitative-easing-and-the-balance-sheet-channel) · [Paper PDF — add link](#) · [Repository — add link](#)
:::

::: {.project-feature}
### Israel Bilateral Defense Trade

A partner-level analysis of strategic trade patterns, structural breaks, and supplier concentration across defense-relevant product groups.

**Methods:** Two-way fixed effects, difference-in-differences, breakpoint analysis, and concentration measures  
**Status:** Graduate econometrics project

[Project overview](projects.qmd#israel-bilateral-defense-trade) · [Paper PDF — add link](#) · [Repository — add link](#)
:::

[Explore all projects](projects.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Current research direction

::: {.initiative}
### AI Economic Intelligence Nexus

I am developing a research program on how economists, public institutions, and policy organizations can use agentic AI and reproducible data systems to identify economic vulnerabilities, interpret strategic change, and support institutional decision-making.

This initiative is presented as a **concept in development**. Its purpose is to connect econometrics, political economy, governance, and responsible AI—not to substitute automated output for scholarly judgment.

[Read the research agenda](research.qmd#economic-intelligence-and-governance)
:::
